issues.problem: “机器替世界做表征” is understandable but slightly compressed; the source is about machine-made representations themselves, not necessarily machines acting on behalf of the world.
issues.suggestion: Consider “机器制造出的表征” or “机器生成的世界表征” for cleaner technical prose.

issues.problem: “像围海造田那样替我们挡一挡” conveys the polder metaphor, but “围海造田” can foreground land reclamation more than flood defense.
issues.suggestion: Consider “像圩田/堤围一样” if you want the flood-defense image to be sharper.

reviews.notes: The translation reads as natural Chinese technical essay prose rather than direct sentence-by-sentence transfer. It preserves Ernie’s playful bluntness, code-switching, product names, links, MDX structure, captions, and attribution without reader-facing meaning drift.

issues.location: paragraph after final image, sentence about model trade-off
issues.problem: “通用性和特异性”略显英式直译；这里的 specificity 更像“针对性”或“专用性”，不是统计/医学语境里的“特异性”。
issues.suggestion: 可改为“通用性和针对性之间存在某种取舍”。

reviews.notes: 译文整体是自然的中文技术随笔语气，不是逐句硬译；保留了原文的玩笑、 bluntness、代码/产品名与必要 code-switching，MDX 和链接结构也未见破损。
